answer: A head is admitted only when three marbles from unrelated branches sign one quill for it; each marble locks its anchor behind that signature, forfeited if the head is unmasked. A marble carrying j live quills may sign again only against an anchor of base×2^j locked by the newcomer — so an operator packing k clones through the same branches pays base×2^k per clone each epoch, while one honest head still finds hungry marbles at plain base. Skipping to fresh branches means bribing marbles whose price rises with every forfeit their signer has eaten.
